1 Talk, conversation,

प्रलभ् {c1c} A. To cheat, deceive;
cf. विप्रलभ्.

1 Obtaining, gaining,
attaining.
--2 Deceiving, imposing upon,
cheating, overreaching.

प्रलंब a.
1 Pendulous, hanging
down; as in प्रलंबकेश.
--2 Prominent;
as in प्रलंबनासिकः.
--3 Slow, dilatory.
--बः
1 Hanging on or from,
depending.
--2 Anything hanging down.
--3 A branch.
--4 A garland worn
round the neck.
--5 A kind of
necklace.
--6 The female breast.
--7 Tin
or lead.
--8 N. of a demon killed by
Balarāma.
--9 A shoot of the
vinepalm.
--10 A cucumber.
--11 A
verse (गाथा).
--Comp.
--अंडः a man
with hanging testicles.
--घ्नः, --मथनः,
--हन् m. epithets of Balarāma.

प्रालंब a. Pendent, hanging
down; प्रालबद्विगुणितचामरप्रहासः

.
--बः
1 A kind of
[]
pearl-ornament.
--2 A female breast.
--बं A
garland worn round the neck and
reaching to the breast; प्रालंबमुत्कृष्य
यथावकाशं निनाय साचीकृतचारुक्त्रः

प्रलंबित a. Pendulous, hanging
down, suspended.

प्रलंबीकृ {c8c} U. To cause to hang
down, suspend.

प्रललाट a. Having a prominent
forehead.

1 A fragment, chip, bit.
--2 The sheath of a leaf.

प्रलवित्रं An instrument for cutting
off.

To become
dissolved, melt away.
--2 To be absorbed
or dissolved in, be resolved into;
आत्मना कृतिना च त्वमात्मन्येव प्रलीयसे

.
--3 To vanish, disappear; सह मेघेन
तडित्प्रलीयते

1 Destruction, annihilation,
dissolution; स्यानानि किं हिमवतः
प्रलयं गतानि

; प्रलयं
नीत्वा Śi. 11. 66 ‘causing to disappear’.
[]
--2 The destruction of the whole
universe (at the end of a kalpa),
universal destruction;

.
--3 Any extensive
destruction or devastation.
--4 Death,
dying, destruction; प्रारब्धाः प्रलयाय
मांसवदहो विक्रेतुमेते वयं

.
--5 Swoon,
fainting, loss of consciousness, syncope;
प्रलयांतोन्मिषिते विलोचने

.
--6 (In Rhet.) Loss of
consciousness, considered as one of the 33
subordinate feelings; प्रलयः
सुखदुःखाद्यैर्गाढमिंद्रियमूर्छनं Pratāparudra.
--7
The mystic syllable om.
--Comp.
--कालः the time of universal
destruction.
--जलधरः a cloud at the
dissolution of the world.
--दहनः the
fire at the dissolution of the world.
--पयोधिः the ocean at the
dissolution of the world.

प्रलीन p. p.
1 Melted, dissolved.
--2 Annihilated, destroyed.
--3
Insensible, unconscious.

To roll along the
ground, roll, wallow; प्रलुठितमवनौ
विलोक्य कृत्तं

To be greedy or
desirous, be lustful.
--2 To allure,
seduce, entice.
--3 To pollute
(through lust). --Caus. To allure,
attract, entice, seduce.

1 Attracting.
--2 An
allurement, seduction, temptation.
--3
A lure, bait.

प्रलोभिन् a.
1 Greedy of, lusting
after.
--2 Alluring, enticing.

प्रलोभ्य a. To be desired or coveted,
attractive, alluring.

प्रलेपः An unguent, an ointment,
a salve; आलिंपन्नमृतमयैरिव प्रलेपैः

प्रलेपक a. Anointing, smearing.
--कः
1 An anointer, a plasterer.
--2
A kind of slow fever.

प्रलोल a. Greatly agitated or
tremulous.

प्रालंबिका A kind of golden
necklace.

प्रालेयं Snow, frost, hoar frost,
